after.zh: 深度可分离卷积把空间处理和通道混合分开。它可以减少计算，但一个输入通道对应的空间核要供各输出共享；普通卷积可以为不同输出选择不同的空间核。在这个单输入、一个空间核的例子中，两个独立方向无法同时由同一个核产生。增加中间通道可以改变这种限制，也会增加计算。
after.en: Depthwise separable convolution separates spatial processing from channel mixing. It can reduce computation, but the spatial kernel for an input channel is shared across outputs; ordinary convolution can choose different spatial kernels for each output. In this one-input, one-spatial-kernel example, two independent directions cannot both come from the same kernel. More intermediate channels can change this limit, at additional cost.

t.zh: 手机需要省计算，但省下的计算会不会带来代价？这次比较两种卷积结构，看看它们能做出什么样的空间特征。
t.en: Phones need to save computation, but does saving computation have a cost? Compare two convolution structures and see which spatial features they can produce.

t.zh: 实验简化为一个输入通道、两个输出通道。图中每个 3×3 方格表示输入通道对一个输出的空间核，亮格的权重为 1，暗格为 0，灰格为 0.5。
t.en: This experiment uses one input channel and two output channels. Each 3×3 grid is the spatial kernel from the input to one output: white has weight 1, black 0 and grey 0.5.

t.zh: 普通卷积给两个输出各用一个空间核；深度可分离卷积先用一个空间核处理输入，再送到两个输出。这里两个逐点混合权重固定为 1；空间核可以选择。
t.en: Ordinary convolution uses a separate spatial kernel for each output. Depthwise separable convolution first applies one spatial kernel to the input, then sends the result to both outputs. Here the two pointwise mixing weights are fixed at 1; you can choose the spatial kernels.

t.zh: 台上的计算量只数每个位置的乘法：普通卷积两个 3×3 核需要 18 次；分离结构一个 3×3 核加两个逐点乘法需要 11 次。真实网络还有加法等开销。
t.en: The bench counts only multiplications per position: two ordinary 3×3 kernels need 18; one spatial kernel plus two pointwise multiplications needs 11. Real networks also have additions and other costs.

brief.zh: 比较两种卷积结构：先在计算预算内做出相同的两个空间核，再尝试做出不同的两个核。
brief.en: Compare two convolution structures: first make two identical spatial kernels within a computation budget, then try to make two different kernels.

hint.zh: 深度可分离结构中，两个输出共享空间核 1；普通卷积的两个空间核可以分别选择。
hint.en: In the separable structure both outputs share spatial kernel 1; ordinary convolution can choose its two spatial kernels independently.

note.zh: 两张目标都需要横向的空间核。调整结构和核，让结果符合目标，乘法次数不超过 11。
note.en: Both targets need a horizontal spatial kernel. Adjust the structure and kernels to match them using at most 11 multiplications.

win.zh: 共享空间核可以满足两个相同的目标，再分别送到两个输出。
win.en: A shared spatial kernel meets both identical targets, then feeds both outputs.

note.zh: 现在第一张目标要横向核，第二张要纵向核。先试试深度可分离结构：调整空间核 1 时，两张结果怎样变化？再选出能同时满足目标的结构。
note.en: Now the first target needs a horizontal kernel and the second a vertical one. Try the separable structure first: what happens to both results when you change spatial kernel 1? Then choose a structure that meets both targets.

win.zh: 这个例子中，一个共享空间核不能同时变成横向和纵向；普通卷积可以分别选择两个核。
win.en: In this example one shared spatial kernel cannot be both horizontal and vertical; ordinary convolution can choose two kernels independently.
